name: app-daylight-and-sleep-glass-tracker
title: Daylight and sleep tracker screens with glass cards and low-poly clouds
whatItIs: Two phone screens on cobalt. The left is a sky gradient with a progress bar, small info tiles and a sunrise arc; the right is a pink-peach gradient with glass cards containing bar and stage charts for daylight and sleep. Low-poly grey clouds float at the edges.
whatItMeans: Optimistic and natural: the background gradient itself expresses time of day.
techniques: Make the whole screen gradient match the subject (sky vs sunset).
Use frosted cards holding data over the gradient for legibility and depth.
Pair monospace labels with big numbers for a precise, scientific accent.
Add 3D low-poly props outside the phones to bridge the UI and the poster.

vocabulary.definition: A background that changes to reflect time or state.
A chart showing categories (sleep stages) over time.
3D shapes built from few flat facets.
A curved timeline showing the sun's path.
